entities.name: Nonce
entities.description: The Nonce information element transfers a 32-bit nonce value to support deriving a new mapped EPS security context. It is a type 3 information element with a length of 5 octets.

entities.name: Nonce IEI
entities.description: The Nonce Information Element Identifier field occupies bits 5-8 of octet 1 in the Nonce information element.

entities.name: Nonce value
entities.description: This field contains the binary representation of the 32-bit nonce. Bit 8 of octet 2 is the most significant bit and bit 1 of octet 5 is the least significant bit.

entities.name: Derive new mapped EPS security context
entities.description: The purpose of the Nonce information element is to support deriving a new mapped EPS security context using the transferred 32-bit nonce value.

relations.description: The Nonce information element contains the Nonce IEI field as part of its structure.
The Nonce information element contains the Nonce value field which holds the 32-bit nonce.
The Nonce information element is used to establish the derivation of a new mapped EPS security context.
